task:
Create a Pod named 'multi-container-playground' in namespace 'default' with THREE containers:

  Container 1 — name: c1
    Image: nginx:1.21
    Env var: SVC=nginx-svc

  Container 2 — name: c2
    Image: busybox:1.35
    Command: ['sh', '-c', 'while true; do date >> /var/log/date.log; sleep 1; done']
    Mounts emptyDir volume 'logs' at /var/log

  Container 3 — name: c3
    Image: busybox:1.35
    Command: ['sh', '-c', 'tail -f /var/log/date.log']
    Mounts the same emptyDir volume 'logs' at /var/log

After creation, verify c2 is writing and c3 can read:
  kubectl exec multi-container-playground -c c3 -- tail /var/log/date.log
hints: All 3 containers go under spec.containers[] in the same Pod
emptyDir volume is shared between c2 and c3
env var: spec.containers[0].env: [{name: SVC, value: nginx-svc}]
detailed_hints: Add c2 and c3 to the containers array, add the emptyDir volume

validators.command: kubectl get pod multi-container-playground -n {namespace} -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers}' | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)))"

validators.description: emptyDir volume named logs is defined
